decisions.reason: Having survived its first market year and fitting closely with the firm's core camera business, it is likely performing at or near aspiration levels and does not justify redeploying resources.
Its modular multi-model line, strong fit with existing capabilities, and prior visible market commitment make withdrawal within the next year very unlikely.
This sensor suite is a related extension of established competences and, absent clear evidence of underperformance, organisational slack supports continued commercialization despite some uncertainty.
As a newly launched radiation-hard camera line with a dedicated page and close technological fit, it is likely to be given time to prove itself before any resource reallocation is considered.

Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly marketed and serves a narrower niche, its results are more uncertain, but the firm's slack and reuse of core imaging know-how still make retention more likely than withdrawal.
